items.title: Nothing Unveils Ear (note): Earbuds With an AI Recorder Charging Case
items.summary: Nothing confirmed that its next product, the Ear (note), pairs wireless earbuds with a charging case that records and transcribes conversations. The case can capture in-person meetings while the earbuds handle phone calls; launch is set for December 8, 2026, with pricing and subscription details still undisclosed.

items.title: CNET Review: Samsung Galaxy Buds On Are Its Best Open-Earbuds Yet
items.summary: David Carnoy scored Samsung's first clip-on open-ear buds 8.0, praising the secure fit, 9.5-hour battery rating and call noise reduction. He found the sound full for an open design but weaker than Bose's Ultra Open Earbuds, and flagged the $229 price and lack of standard multipoint.

items.title: TechRadar Refreshes Best Wireless Earbuds Guide for November 2026
items.summary: TechRadar's buying guide keeps the Technics EAH-AZ100 at the top, citing magnetic-fluid drivers, triple-device Bluetooth and strong active noise cancellation. Its November 24 update expanded the also-consider section to 24 models as Black Friday shopping begins.

items.title: SOUNDPEATS Air6 Pro Launches in Australia With 58dB ANC and Bluetooth 6.0
items.summary: The Air6 Pro brings second-generation Air Series tuning, an 11mm driver, LDAC and aptX Lossless support, and adaptive noise cancellation rated up to 58dB. It went on sale in Australia on November 16 at A$113.99, with up to 52 hours of claimed total playback.

items.title: Xiaomi Clip Debuts Globally as the Company's First Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds
items.summary: Unveiled in Paris on November 17, the Clip uses 5.5g earbuds, an 11mm driver, LHDC 5.0 and a shape-memory alloy bridge, with up to 38 hours of battery. It sells for GBP 129.99 in the UK and supports Apple's Find My network for the charging case.

items.title: Lava Launches Probuds Xplore 13 True Wireless Earbuds in India
items.summary: Lava's budget TWS pair went on sale in India on November 16 at Rs 969, with 13mm drivers, Bluetooth 5.4, IPX5 protection and a claimed 30 hours with the case. The outlet notes the earbuds use intelligent noise cancellation rather than true active noise cancellation.

items.title: Urban Q9i TWS Earbuds Put a Phone Stand in the Charging Case
items.summary: Urban launched the Q9i in India on November 10 at Rs 4,999, combining Bluetooth 6.0, 13mm drivers and a groove in the case that props up a phone. The article flags that translation depends on a third-party smartphone app and that battery and codec details are not published.

items.title: Sony Brings LinkBuds Clip Open-Ear Earbuds to India at Rs 18,990
items.summary: Sony launched its clip-on LinkBuds Clip in India on November 4 with AI voice pickup, three listening modes and Fast Pair. The buds offer nine hours per charge and 37 hours with the case, placing them between budget clip-ons and Bose's premium models.

items.title: True Wireless Shipments Fall for First Time Since 2023 as Open-Ear Grows 12%
items.summary: Citing Omdia's Q2 2026 tracker, the report says global TWS shipments slipped 0.7% to 82.1 million units while open-ear shipments rose 12% to 11.1 million. Clip-ons took 61% of the open-ear segment and the sub-$50 tier grew 323% year over year.

items.title: Open-Ear Earbuds Boom While Traditional TWS Stalls, Omdia Data Shows
items.summary: eCoustics analyzes Omdia figures showing open-ear products at 13.5% of TWS shipments, with the $100-$199 tier up 253%. The article argues the segment is splitting by use case, with sealed buds retaining an advantage in isolation and open designs winning on comfort and awareness.
